entry_format: Every number is {"value", "unit", "kind", "source"} (some add "note"). A section may hold groups of entries. Keys read with dots: frame.width_pixels. Builders add their own section (with an "about" line); they never change another section's numbers without saying so.

kinds.measured: the project measured it (a recording, a render, a bill, a fit to a picture): change it only by measuring again
kinds.judged: a person or a helper chose it by looking or by a rule of thumb: change it only after looking again
kinds.invented: nobody has tested it yet: a starting point; say so whenever a result rests on it

A view's one-off exceptions go in its place facts "accepted" list, not here.
